verdict.rationale: The Torch developer platform documents APIs (Case Status, FOIA) and a sandbox for sending test data, but only after account registration and team onboarding. Nothing shows an interactive, explorable API reference with runnable examples, so the only runnable surface is a gated test environment. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference or try-it console, runnable code examples, public ungated access to the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
